HPE 40GB Dual Port 565QSFP+ Network Adapter Card (P05765-001) – High-Speed Networking for Bangladesh

Upgrade your enterprise or data center network with the HPE 40GB Dual Port 565QSFP+ Network Adapter Card (P05765-001). Designed to deliver ultra-fast and reliable connectivity, this adapter is ideal for Bangladeshi IT professionals and businesses demanding high bandwidth, low latency, and robust network performance.

Key Features:

  • Dual 40Gbps QSFP+ ports supporting high-speed data transfer
  • PCI Express 3.0 x8 interface for seamless integration with servers
  • Supports Ethernet 10Gb/40Gb and InfiniBand FDR protocols
  • Hot-pluggable design for easy installation and maintenance
  • Advanced thermal management for stable performance under load
  • Compatible with HPE ProLiant Gen10 servers and other QSFP+ enabled devices
  • Supports both UEFI and legacy BIOS boot modes

Technical Specifications:

  • Model: HPE P05765-001
  • Chipset: Intel XL710
  • Data Rate: 40 Gbps per port (80 Gbps total)
  • Ports: 2 x QSFP+
  • Interface: PCI Express 3.0 x8
  • Supported Protocols: Ethernet 10Gb/40Gb, InfiniBand FDR
  • Compatible Servers: HPE ProLiant DL360 Gen10, DL380 Gen10, others
  • Power Consumption: Approx. 25W
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 55°C
  • Boot Support: UEFI and legacy BIOS
